leverageConfirm.title: Liquidation possible, no stop
leverageConfirm.body_long: {{leverage}}x, stop loss off. If price falls {{pct}}% below the last safety order ({{price}}), the position is liquidated and the cycle's whole budget is lost.
leverageConfirm.body_short: {{leverage}}x, stop loss off. If price rises {{pct}}% above the last safety order ({{price}}), the position is liquidated and the cycle's whole budget is lost.
leverageConfirm.bodyGeneric: {{leverage}}x, stop loss off. Past the last safety order nothing closes the position before liquidation, and the cycle's whole budget is lost.
leverageConfirm.hint: A stop loss or 1x leverage removes this risk.
leverageConfirm.body_grid: Grid at {{leverage}}x, stop-out off. Est. liquidation low / high: {{price}}. If price reaches it, the position is liquidated and the cycle's whole budget is lost.
leverageConfirm.bodyGenericGrid: Grid at {{leverage}}x, stop-out off. Outside the range nothing closes the position before liquidation, and the cycle's whole budget is lost.
leverageConfirm.hintShort: Only a stop loss removes this risk: a short is liquidated at 1x too, when price about doubles.

live.title: Real money
live.confirmBody: Every buy and sell this bot simulates is sent to Binance futures as a market order on {{symbol}}, isolated margin, {{leverage}}x. A stop stays on the exchange at the bot's stop level. If the position on Binance changes outside the bot, the bot stops. Taker fees apply.
live.buildOff: This build trades on paper only.
live.futuresOnly: Real money is available for Binance futures bots only.

req.title: Before real money
req.key: A verified trade key (Binance, Bybit or OKX)
req.stop: A stop loss, grid stop-out or drawdown stop

live.listLine: Paper by default: simulated fills at live prices, fees included. Real money is opt-in per bot on Binance, Bybit or OKX futures.
live.pilot: Pilot: {{count}} cycles left at {{pct}}% of the simulated size. Ending it takes effect from the next cycle.
live.confirmBodyVenue: Every buy and sell this bot simulates is sent to {{exchange}} futures as a market order on {{symbol}}, isolated margin, {{leverage}}x. Decisions still use Binance prices. A stop stays on the exchange at the bot's stop level. If the position on the exchange changes outside the bot, the bot stops. Taker fees apply.

report.title: Real vs simulated fills
report.note: Positive slippage is a cost: paid more on a buy, received less on a sell. One market order can mirror several simulated fills.
